TaskForce is moving to your desktop.

Your projects, tasks and notes, together in one app. And the Claude Code AI when a task needs a hand.

Download for Windows: https://taskforce-project.fr/download
Windows 10 and 11. Also on Linux, and soon on Mac.


Hi {{ contact.FIRSTNAME|default:"there" }},

You were one of the first people to use TaskForce, so you are among the first to hear it: TaskForce is now a desktop app. Same account, same interface, and your work stays with you.


PLAN, HAND OVER, REMEMBER

- Plan: projects, tasks and a roadmap, on one board.
- Hand over: give a task to Claude Code, it gets on with it on your computer.
- Remember: your notes link to each other and to your projects, in the Brain OS.

It all stays with you: your projects live on your computer, the app collects nothing about how you use it, and it works without internet after the first sign-in.


THREE STEPS, AND YOU ARE IN (WINDOWS)

1. Download: TaskForce-Setup-1.2.1.exe, from https://taskforce-project.fr/download
2. Install: no administrator rights needed.
3. Sign in: with your TaskForce account.

If Windows shows a warning, that is expected: the app does not have the digital signature of the big publishers yet. The install guide explains each message: https://taskforce-project.fr/download#install
The VirusTotal report shows the file scanned by dozens of antivirus programs: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/fbde7957158d715ba9b626e6056cd466da49f00af149d4b72f0a33e3a46a79c0
Need a hand? Email me at contact@taskforce-project.fr and I will walk you through it.
After that, the app updates itself.


BRING IT ALONG, OR START FRESH

I already use TaskForce
Sign in with the same account, then click Operations, From the web app, Copy everything: your workspaces arrive with their projects and notes.
It is a copy: the web version keeps everything until it closes (date to come, an email will tell you). To redo by hand: your teammates, connected tools and AI settings.
How to bring your work: https://taskforce-project.fr/migrate

I'm starting fresh
Create your free account from the app, go through the three-step setup, then create your first project.
Claude Code turns on in one click in Settings, Agents, if it is installed on your computer and signed in to your Claude account.


BUILT IN THE OPEN

All the code is public and free. No need to code to help: a two-line email counts too.
- Explore the project and star it: https://github.com/taskforce-project/taskforce-fullstack
- Share feedback: contact@taskforce-project.fr, or report a problem on GitHub: https://github.com/taskforce-project/taskforce-fullstack/issues/new/choose


YOUR DESKTOP IS WAITING.

Download for Windows: https://taskforce-project.fr/download

The best way to judge it is to try it on a real project. Tell me what you think.

Pierre Michel
